name: young-cohorts-only
about: §4R L2: a young account — every cohort is younger than 28 days, so the sheet holds counts and no rates at all.

output.headline: November 3, 2026: 1 campaign ran, spending $75.00 for 3 leads at $25.00 each.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet was the only campaign active, delivering 3,900 impressions, 48 clicks at a 1.2% click rate, and 3 leads for $75.00 spent.
Month to date in November 2026, Meta spend sits at $225.00 with 28 days still to run.
The 2026-10-19 cohort (9 leads) has 8 contacted, 4 converted to applicants, 2 applied, and 1 hired — it is still too young to judge by rates.
The 2026-10-26 cohort (14 leads) has 10 contacted, 3 converted to applicants, 1 applied, 0 hired, and 2 lost after conversion — also too young to judge by rates.
Qualified leads and leads lost before becoming applicants are not recorded in the system.
